subject.title: fix(openai-embedding): re-add openai/ prefix for proxy providers even with bare model IDs

question: Should OpenClaw treat every non-native OpenAI-compatible embedding base URL as requiring an `openai/` provider-qualified model, or support qualification only where the endpoint contract explicitly requires it?
rationale: The branch changes a compatibility policy for arbitrary configured endpoints; Requesty evidence alone cannot establish a safe universal contract.

options.title: Narrow the routing contract
options.body: Define and implement qualification only for endpoints or provider configurations with an established requirement, while preserving existing generic OpenAI-compatible behavior.

options.title: Adopt universal qualification
options.body: Document that every non-native OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint receives `openai/<model>` and accept the resulting compatibility break for endpoints that require bare IDs.

recommendation.title: Narrow the routing contract
recommendation.body: Define and implement qualification only for endpoints or provider configurations with an established requirement, while preserving existing generic OpenAI-compatible behavior.
